newsitem.title: NORWAY: NORDIC SKIING-TEAM SKI JUMPING POSTPONED.
newsitem.headline: NORDIC SKIING-TEAM SKI JUMPING POSTPONED.

text.p: Bad weather forced organisers to postpone Thursday's ski jumping team competition at the Nordic skiing world championships.
Organisers hoped the event, due to start at 1400 local time (1300 GMT), could begin an hour later.
There was poor visibility because of heavy snowfalls and a thick layer of fresh snow had to be removed from the hill, they said.
